question: can the declared ceilings be enforced, and would the executed episodes have passed them
design: ceilings cannot be applied inside a provider call, so they are enforced at scoring admission against measured usage; the module requires the quantity to be named and refuses to guess
applied_to: the six executed cost episodes, which are the only episodes with complete measured usage

result_under_the_manuscript_ceiling.reading: had the declared ceiling been enforced as a total-token limit, every executed episode would have been inadmissible

result_under_the_other_interpretation.reading: the same episodes sit comfortably inside the same number when it is read as marginal tokens

consequence: the ceiling was never defined against a measured quantity, so it had no truth value; the verdict is determined entirely by which quantity is named
claim_scope: protocol-compliance evidence only; six episodes on one burned task
